description: While resolving a speaker-ID mis-tag in the Ronald/Susie financial call transcript, asked David for Susie's last name instead of recognizing she is his wife and looking it up. identity/MEMORY.md and contacts both readily identify her.
correction: Susie is David's wife (identity/MEMORY.md, Family section). Contacts lookup confirms her name as Susie O'Hara (highest-scoring, most recently active contact, tied to her personal email at everydayentries.com). This matches the name already recorded in the transcript and workflows/plaud-ingest/state.yaml speaker-mappings, so no textual correction to the transcript was required after verification -- the failure was in the process (asking) not in the underlying data.
systemic_fix: Before asking David for identifying information about a named person appearing in transcripts, email, or calendar entries, always check identity/MEMORY.md and contacts first. Family members especially must never require lookup-by-question -- their identity should be resolvable from existing context every time.
